hooks.ambush: Intercept a hostile patrol before it can complete its sweep.
hooks.annihilation: Break the hostile formation contesting the district.
hooks.dominate: Secure the operational ground before the opposition can consolidate.
hooks.extraction: Recover the designated asset and move it to safety.
hooks.focal_point: Take the key position and hold it against counterattack.
hooks.general_melee: Engage the opposing force and clear the contested field.
hooks.control_the_field: Secure the field and deny the opposition control.
hooks.hold_the_line: Defend the assigned position against the approaching force.
hooks.objective_raid: Raid the assigned objectives before the enemy can react.
hooks.sensor_check: Gather intelligence and preserve the scouting force.
hooks.steel_rain: Secure the marked ground under combat pressure.
hooks.urban_sweep: Search the urban sector and secure the assigned objectives.

dispatch: Operations staff requests a readiness check before the next advance.
Command reminds lance leaders to coordinate movement and recovery.
Planning staff updates the next day's orders from confirmed reports.
